tests_may_change_note: None: the existing Bun adapter tests use handlers that do not throw, and new cases are new tests.

naive_patches.naive.patch: Wraps each handler call in try/catch and forwards to onError, but ignores the promise an async handler returns, so a rejection never reaches onError.

hidden_tests_note: The upstream fix's own onError tests, run over both copies (hono/bun in src/adapter/bun and the @hono/bun package in adapters/bun, loaded by path at run time; it needs no Bun, only the build), so a run that leaves the in-scope package copy alone fails half. Changes from upstream: the 'rethrow when onError is not set' check is folded into the first test (it passes on the base); the async test waits for setTimeout(0) instead of one microtask; and it also checks async onOpen and onClose (audit A).
issue_hints_removed: the issue's diagnosis that Bun only catches exceptions when the handler object has an error method
scope_out_note: src/helper/websocket/ was dropped (audit A): the ticket does not put the shared helper out of scope, and widening onError's event type there so apps can read `error` is reasonable.
